steps.message: In Simple Calendar Pro, create a calendar event for tomorrow at 19h with the title 'Catch up on Annual Report' and the description 'We will prepare for upcoming project milestones. Looking forward to productive discussions.'. The event should last for 15 mins.

Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/calendars --projection _id:calendar_displayName:account_name:account_type:visible:calendar_access_level"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/calendars --projection _id:calendar_displayName:account_name:account_type:visible:calendar_access_level""
